_help: Weekly homelab routine. min is a rough time estimate. focus rotates by ISO week number.

tasks.d: Run updates on Proxmox first, then each VM. Take a snapshot before any kernel or domain controller update.

tasks.t: Triage this week's Security Onion alerts
tasks.d: Open Alerts, sort by severity, close the noise with a note, and write down one thing you do not understand yet.
Generate a known alert from a lab VM and confirm it appears. If it does not, fix the pipeline before anything else.
Open the Proxmox backup log. Once a month, restore one VM to a new ID and boot it.

tasks.t: Harden one system and update its score
tasks.d: Pick the lowest score on the checklist and fix two or three items.

tasks.t: One attack from Kali, one detection from Security Onion
tasks.d: Run a single technique against a lab target, then find what it left in the logs. Write the result as a note.
Turn the week's notes into a short incident-style report. Writing is the skill employers see.

tasks.t: Move one credential into the password manager
tasks.d: Rotate one reused password to a generated one. Turn on MFA where it is missing.

tasks.t: One Security+ objective on the site
tasks.d: Read the notes, do the cards, then tie it to something in the lab.
